title: Concept: Go dependency carrying the +incompatible marker
description: go.mod declares a `+incompatible` version, which declares a major version without a matching module path, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The module path no longer identifies the major line, so two incompatible versions can be resolved under one path.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The module path no longer identifies the major line, so two incompatible versions can be resolved under one path.
